Bid Number: DPW 22-34
Bid Title: Riverside Avenue Improvements from 17th to 21st Street
Category: Projects Out to Bid
Status: Open
Additional Status Information: Refer to BID on www.openbids.com
Bid Recipient: Refer to BID on www.openbids.com

Description:

Following the closure of the bid submittal period, bids will be publicly opened and read for performing work as follows:  Furnishing all labor, materials, equipment, and performing all work necessary and incidental to the construction of the project known as Riverside Avenue Improvements from 17th to 21st Street, DPW Project No. 22-34, according to drawings and specifications prepared by the City of El Paso de Robles and according to the Contract Documents. The work shall include, but is not limited to, lowering and raising of utilities, monument perpetuation, dig-out repairs, placement of HMA leveling and surface course, key cut tapers and striping, and installing fiber conduits and manholes. Contractor to provide all necessary work plans, permits, and inspections necessary, all as shown on the plans and/or as specified herein.

Project is to be completed within forty (40) WORKING days from the date specified in the issuance of the Notice to Proceed. The Contractor shall pay to the City of El Paso de Robles the sum of FIVE HUNDRED DOLLARS ($500.00), for each and every CALENDAR day’s delay in finishing the work in excess of the working day completion time.
